summary: Slateport Center interface fixture retains stale Endless Candy Bag tasks
symptom: START did not open the field menu and FIELD_MENU_CURSOR could not move because old Bag/party target tasks still owned input.

unexpected.predicted: The forward Center checkpoint is a clean battle-inactive overworld state suitable for opening party preparation menus.
unexpected.actual: RAM mode was overworld, but active task payloads and retained text showed Use on which Pokémon? with FIELD_PARTY_CURSOR=7; START was ignored.
diff: The selected fixture was battle-inactive but still owned by an Endless Candy Bag/party-target task.
The generic mode label overworld was insufficient to prove a clean field-input boundary.

authority.oracle: A clean preparation fixture must have field message mode 0, no verified Bag task, no Start-menu task, six valid party records, and a stable compact RAM hash on two launches.
sources: Lua task inspection and verified Bag-task payload signature
Encrypted party records and protected checkpoint SHA-256

reproduction.command: Launch the fixture twice with client.mgba_clone.disposable_clone and inspect RunBunAdapter.observe(), _field_bag_task(), FIELD_PARTY_CURSOR, and active tasks before input.
steps: Load only the historical fixture in a disposable muted clone.
Read field mode, retained text, party cursor, and active task payloads without input.
Confirm the Bag-task signature owns input and START is not a legal clean-overworld action.
reproduction.observed: Both probes exposed retained Use on which Pokémon? state, FIELD_PARTY_CURSOR 7, and active Endless Candy Bag/party-target tasks.

hypotheses.claim: Battle inactive plus mode overworld proves no field menu owns input.
hypotheses.result: falsified by the active Bag task and ignored START input.
verified twice with identical RAM hash cb5a0d58281816f7 and no Bag/Start task.

root_cause.claim: The Rhyhorn Lv17 checkpoint was saved before the reusable Endless Candy target layer had closed; preparation-fixture legality therefore requires task ownership checks in addition to battle/mode labels.
evidence: The stale fixture reproduces the exact Bag task payload and party-target cursor on two isolated launches.
A separate Center checkpoint passes the full clean-boundary oracle twice with the same state hash.
alternatives_falsified: The live authoritative emulator caused the stale menu state

solution.contract_change: Disposable preparation fixtures must pass explicit field-task ownership checks; mode=overworld alone is not a clean-input precondition.

targeted_checks.name: two-run clean Center fixture oracle
targeted_checks.command: Launch slateport-center-healed-forward-20260809.ss twice through disposable_clone and assert map 9:11 at 7,4, field mode 0, no Bag task, no Start task, party count 6, and state hash cb5a0d58281816f7.
targeted_checks.evidence: Both runs returned the same canonical hash and every clean-boundary invariant.

regression_checks.name: full Python suite
regression_checks.evidence: 106 tests passed; one opt-in macOS UI integration test skipped without its fixture variable.

replay.expected: Clean Center field boundary with no menu owner and a stable six-member party.
replay.actual: Both clean-fixture runs returned state hash cb5a0d58281816f7, map 9:11 at 7,4, field mode 0, no Bag/Start task, and party count 6.

domain_knowledge: A Run & Bun field menu may retain input ownership while battle is inactive and the generic mode classifier says overworld.
regression_cases: slateport-rhyhorn-l17-forward-20260809.state is the stale Bag-task fixture; slateport-center-healed-forward-20260809.ss is the clean preparation fixture.
tooling_contracts: Mutating field interfaces must reject active Bag/Start tasks unless that exact interface owns and verifies the menu transition.
